Authors: Yuhan Jin, Nayari Marie Lessa, Mariela De Lucas Alvarez, Melvin Laux, Lucas Amparo Barbosa, Frank Kirchner, Rebecca Adam

Actuation space reduction to facilitate insightful shape matching in a novel reconfigurable tendon driven continuum manipulator

简要说明：本研究针对一种新型可重构肌腱驱动连续体机械臂，提出了一种基于曲率-扭转投影的无模型控制框架，通过简化的顺序形状匹配策略实现形状控制。

TLDR: This paper presents a model-free control framework for a novel reconfigurable tendon-driven continuum manipulator, using curvature-torsion projection to enable a simplified sequential shape-matching strategy.

Abstract: In tendon driven continuum manipulators (TDCMs), reconfiguring the tendon routing enables tailored spatial deformation of the backbone. This work presents a design in which tendons can be rerouted either prior to or after actuation by actively rotating the individual spacer disks. Each disk rotation thus adds a degree of freedom to the actuation space, complicating the mapping from a desired backbone curve to the corresponding actuator inputs. However, when the backbone shape is projected into an intermediate space defined by curvature and torsion (C-T), patterns emerge that highlight which disks are most influential in achieving a global shape. This insight enables a simplified, sequential shape-matching strategy: first, the proximal and intermediate disks are rotated to approximate the global shape; then, the distal disks are adjusted to fine-tune the end-effector position with minimal impact on the overall shape. The proposed actuation framework offers a model-free alternative to conventional control approaches, bypassing the complexities of modeling reconfigurable TDCMs.

摘要（中文）：在肌腱驱动连续体操纵器（TDCM）中，通过重新配置肌腱布线能够实现脊柱结构的定制化空间变形。本研究提出一种设计方案，即通过主动旋转各独立间隔盘，可在驱动前或驱动后对肌腱路径进行重定向。每个间隔盘的旋转由此为驱动空间增加了一个自由度，使得从期望的脊柱曲线到相应驱动器输入的映射关系变得复杂。然而，当脊柱形状投影到由曲率和挠率（C-T）定义的中间空间时，会呈现出特定模式，揭示哪些间隔盘对实现整体形状最具影响力。这一洞见促成了一种简化的顺序形状匹配策略：首先旋转近端和中间间隔盘以逼近整体形状；随后调整远端间隔盘，在最小化对整体形状影响的同时微调末端执行器位置。所提出的驱动框架为传统控制方法提供了一种无模型替代方案，规避了可重构TDCM建模的复杂性。

Authors: Sabyasachi Dash, John Golden, Girish Krishnan

Learning step-level dynamic soaring in shear flow

简要说明：本研究利用深度强化学习，学习在剪切流中实现动态翱翔的步级状态反馈控制策略，表明无需显式规划，高效的能量收集飞行可以通过与流动的局部交互自然涌现。

TLDR: This paper uses deep reinforcement learning to learn step-level, state-feedback control policies for dynamic soaring in shear flows, showing that efficient energy-harvesting flight can emerge from local interactions without explicit planning.

Abstract: Dynamic soaring enables sustained flight by extracting energy from wind shear, yet it is commonly understood as a cycle-level maneuver that assumes stable flow conditions. In realistic unsteady environments, however, such assumptions are often violated, raising the question of whether explicit cycle-level planning is necessary. Here, we show that dynamic soaring can emerge from step-level, state-feedback control using only local sensing, without explicit trajectory planning. Using deep reinforcement learning as a tool, we obtain policies that achieve robust omnidirectional navigation across diverse shear-flow conditions. The learned behavior organizes into a structured control law that coordinates turning and vertical motion, giving rise to a two-phase strategy governed by a trade-off between energy extraction and directional progress. The resulting policy generalizes across varying conditions and reproduces key features observed in biological flight and optimal-control solutions. These findings identify a feedback-based control structure underlying dynamic soaring, demonstrating that efficient energy-harvesting flight can emerge from local interactions with the flow without explicit planning, and providing insights for biological flight and autonomous systems in complex, flow-coupled environments.

摘要（中文）：动态翱翔通过从风切变中提取能量实现持续飞行，但通常被理解为一种基于循环层面的机动策略，其前提是假设稳定的流动条件。然而，在实际的非稳态环境中，这种假设往往难以成立，这引发了一个问题：是否必须进行显式的循环级轨迹规划？本文研究表明，动态翱翔可以通过仅依赖局部感知的步进级状态反馈控制实现，无需显式轨迹规划。利用深度强化学习作为工具，我们获得了能够在不同风切变条件下实现鲁棒全向导航的控制策略。学习到的行为组织成一种结构化控制律，协调转向与垂直运动，形成了一种由能量提取与方向推进之间的权衡所主导的两阶段策略。所得策略能够泛化至多种流动条件，并重现了生物飞行和最优控制解中观察到的关键特征。这些发现揭示了动态翱翔背后基于反馈的控制结构，证明了高效的能量获取飞行可以通过与流动的局部交互自然涌现而无须显式规划，为复杂流动耦合环境中的生物飞行与自主系统提供了新的见解。

Authors: Lunbing Chen, Jixin Lu, Yufei Yin, Jinpeng Huang, Yang Xiang, Hong Liu

Asymptotically Stable Gait Generation and Instantaneous Walkability Determination for Planar Almost Linear Biped with Knees

简要说明：本文提出了一种为带膝盖的平面双足机器人生成稳定步态并进行瞬时可步行性判定的方法，通过对运动方程中的重力项进行线性近似，从而无需数值积分即可实现快速计算。

TLDR: This paper presents a method for generating stable gaits and performing instantaneous walkability determination for a planar bipedal robot with knees, using linear approximations of the gravity term in the equations of motion to enable fast calculations without numerical integration.

Abstract: A class of planar bipedal robots with unique mechanical properties has been proposed, where all links are balanced around the hip joint, preventing natural swinging motion due to gravity. A common property of their equations of motion is that the inertia matrix is a constant matrix, there are no nonlinear velocity terms, and the gravity term contains simple nonlinear terms. By performing a Taylor expansion of the gravity term and making a linear approximation, it is easy to derive a linearized model, and calculations for future states or walkability determination can be performed instantaneously without the need for numerical integration. This paper extends the method to a planar biped robot model with knees. First, we derive the equations of motion, constraint conditions, and inelastic collisions for a planar 6-DOF biped robot, design its control system, and numerically generate a stable bipedal gait on a horizontal plane. Next, we reduce the equations of motion to a 3-DOF model, and derive a linearized model by approximating the gravity term as linear around the expansion point for the thigh frame angle. Through numerical simulations, we demonstrate that calculations for future states and walkability determination can be completed in negligible time. By applying control inputs to the obtained model, performing state-space realization, and then discretizing it, instantaneous walkability determination through iterative calculation becomes possible. Through detailed gait analysis, we discuss how the knee joint flexion angle and the expansion point affect the accuracy of the linear approximation, and the issues that arise when descending a small step.

摘要（中文）：一类具有独特机械特性的平面双足机器人被提出，其所有连杆均围绕髋关节平衡配置，避免了因重力产生的自然摆动运动。该类机器人运动方程的共同特性在于：惯性矩阵为常数矩阵，不存在非线性速度项，且重力项包含简单的非线性项。通过对重力项进行泰勒展开并作线性近似，可便捷推导出线性化模型，无需数值积分即可瞬时完成未来状态计算或步态可行性判定。本文将该方法拓展至含膝关节的平面双足机器人模型。首先推导平面六自由度双足机器人的运动方程、约束条件及非弹性碰撞模型，设计其控制系统，并通过数值方法在水平面上生成稳定的双足步态。随后将运动方程简化为三自由度模型，并通过对大腿框架角度展开点处的重力项进行线性近似，推导出线性化模型。数值仿真表明，未来状态计算与步态可行性判定可在可忽略的时间内完成。通过对所得模型施加控制输入，进行状态空间实现并离散化，可实现基于迭代计算的瞬时步态可行性判定。通过详细步态分析，本文探讨了膝关节屈曲角度与展开点对线性近似精度的影响，以及下踏小台阶时产生的问题。

Authors: Fumihiko Asano, Ning Lei, Taiki Sedoguchi

Robotic Nanoparticle Synthesis via Solution-based Processes

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于螺旋几何的机器人操控规划框架，用于自动化溶液法纳米粒子合成，通过演示编程提取运动约束，以实现长时域、多步骤的任务执行。

TLDR: This paper presents a screw geometry-based manipulation planning framework for robotic automation of solution-based nanoparticle synthesis, using programming by demonstration to extract motion constraints and enable long-horizon, multi-step task execution.

Abstract: We present a screw geometry-based manipulation planning framework for the robotic automation of solution-based synthesis, exemplified through the preparation of gold and magnetite nanoparticles. The synthesis protocols are inherently long-horizon, multi-step tasks, requiring skills such as pick-and-place, pouring, turning a knob, and periodic visual inspection to detect reaction completion. A central challenge is that some skills, notably pouring, transferring containers with solutions, and turning a knob, impose geometric and kinematic constraints on the end-effector motion. To address this, we use a programming by demonstration paradigm where the constraints can be extracted from a single demonstration. This combination of screw-based motion representation and demonstration-driven specification enables domain experts, such as chemists, to readily adapt and reprogram the system for new experimental protocols and laboratory setups without requiring expertise in robotics or motion planning. We extract sequences of constant screws from demonstrations, which compactly encode the motion constraints while remaining coordinate-invariant. This representation enables robust generalization across variations in grasp placement and allows parameterized reuse of a skill learned from a single example. By composing these screw-parameterized primitives according to the synthesis protocol, the robot autonomously generates motion plans that execute the complete experiment over repeated runs. Our results highlight that screw-theoretic planning, combined with programming by demonstration, provides a rigorous and generalizable foundation for long-horizon laboratory automation, thereby enabling fundamental kinematics to have a translational impact on the use of robots in developing scalable solution-based synthesis protocols.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种基于螺旋几何的机器人操作规划框架，用于实现溶液合成过程的自动化，并以金纳米颗粒和磁铁矿纳米颗粒的制备为例进行验证。合成方案本质上是长周期、多步骤的任务，需要拾取放置、倾倒溶液、旋钮调节及周期性视觉检测反应完成度等技能。核心挑战在于部分技能（特别是倾倒溶液、转移容器和旋钮操作）对末端执行器的运动施加了几何与运动学约束。为此，我们采用示教编程范式，通过单次演示即可提取这些约束条件。螺旋运动表示与示教驱动规范的结合，使得化学家等领域专家无需具备机器人学或运动规划专业知识，即可轻松调整并重新编程系统以适应新的实验方案和实验室配置。我们从演示中提取恒定螺旋序列，这种表示方法在保持坐标不变性的同时，紧凑地编码了运动约束，从而实现了对抓取位置变化的鲁棒性泛化，并支持基于单次示例习得技能的参数化复用。通过按照合成方案组合这些螺旋参数化的动作基元，机器人能够自主生成运动规划，在重复运行中执行完整实验。研究结果表明：螺旋理论规划与示教编程相结合，为长周期实验室自动化提供了严谨且可泛化的基础框架，使得基础运动学能够对机器人开发可扩展的溶液合成方案产生实际影响。

Authors: Dasharadhan Mahalingam, Michael Gallagher, Nilanjan Chakraborty, Stanislaus S. Wong

3DRO: Lidar-level SE(3) Direct Radar Odometry Using a 2D Imaging Radar and a Gyroscope

简要说明：本文提出了一种名为3DRO的方法，将2D成像雷达与陀螺仪相结合以实现SE(3)里程计，在自运动估计中达到了激光雷达级别的精度。

TLDR: This paper presents 3DRO, a method that combines a 2D imaging radar with a gyroscope to perform SE(3) odometry, achieving lidar-level accuracy for ego-motion estimation.

Abstract: Recently, the robotics community has regained interest in radar-based perception and state estimation. A 2D imaging radar provides dense 360deg information about the environment. Despite the radar antenna's cone of emission and reception, the collected data is generally assumed to be limited to the plane orthogonal to the radar's spinning axis. Accordingly, most methods based on 2D imaging radars only perform SE(2) state estimation. This paper presents 3DRO, an extension of the SE(2) Direct Radar Odometry (DRO) framework to perform state estimation in SE(3). While still assuming planarity of the data through DRO's 2D velocity estimates, it integrates 3D gyroscope measurements over SO(3) to estimate SE(3) ego motion. While simple, this approach provides lidar-level odometry accuracy as demonstrated using 643km of data from the Boreas-RT dataset.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 近期，机器人学界对基于雷达的感知与状态估计重新产生了兴趣。二维成像雷达可提供周围环境密集的360度信息。尽管雷达天线存在发射与接收锥角限制，但采集到的数据通常被默认限制在垂直于雷达旋转轴的平面内。因此，基于二维成像雷达的方法大多仅进行SE(2)状态估计。本文提出3DRO方法，将SE(2)直接雷达里程计（DRO）框架扩展至SE(3)状态估计。该方法在保持DRO二维速度估计对数据平面性假设的同时，通过SO(3)空间的三轴陀螺仪测量数据融合，实现SE(3)自运动估计。尽管方法简洁，但基于Boreas-RT数据集中643公里数据的验证表明，该方案能达到激光雷达级别的里程计精度。

Authors: Cedric Le Gentil, Daniil Lisus, Timothy D. Barfoot

Safe reinforcement learning with online filtering for fatigue-predictive human-robot task planning and allocation in production

简要说明：本文提出了一种安全强化学习方法，结合粒子滤波，用于协同制造中的实时、疲劳预测的人机任务规划与分配，将疲劳参数视为不确定并在线更新。

TLDR: This paper proposes a safe reinforcement learning approach integrating particle filtering for real-time, fatigue-predictive human-robot task planning and allocation in collaborative manufacturing, treating fatigue parameters as uncertain and updating them online.

Abstract: Human-robot collaborative manufacturing, a core aspect of Industry 5.0, emphasizes ergonomics to enhance worker well-being. This paper addresses the dynamic human-robot task planning and allocation (HRTPA) problem, which involves determining when to perform tasks and who should execute them to maximize efficiency while ensuring workers' physical fatigue remains within safe limits. The inclusion of fatigue constraints, combined with production dynamics, significantly increases the complexity of the HRTPA problem. Traditional fatigue-recovery models in HRTPA often rely on static, predefined hyperparameters. However, in practice, human fatigue sensitivity varies daily due to factors such as changed work conditions and insufficient sleep. To better capture this uncertainty, we treat fatigue-related parameters as inaccurate and estimate them online based on observed fatigue progression during production. To address these challenges, we propose PF-CD3Q, a safe reinforcement learning (safe RL) approach that integrates the particle filter with constrained dueling double deep Q-learning for real-time fatigue-predictive HRTPA. Specifically, we first develop PF-based estimators to track human fatigue and update fatigue model parameters in real-time. These estimators are then integrated into CD3Q by making task-level fatigue predictions during decision-making and excluding tasks that exceed fatigue limits, thereby constraining the action space and formulating the problem as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP).

摘要（中文）：人机协同制造作为工业5.0的核心组成部分，强调以工效学提升工作者福祉。本文针对动态人机任务规划与分配问题展开研究，该问题需确定任务执行时机与执行主体，以在保障工人身体疲劳处于安全限值内的前提下实现效率最大化。疲劳约束的引入与生产动态性相结合，显著增加了人机任务规划与分配问题的复杂性。传统人机任务规划与分配中的疲劳恢复模型常依赖静态预定义超参数，然而在实际生产场景中，人类疲劳敏感性会因工作条件变化、睡眠不足等因素产生每日波动。为更好捕捉这种不确定性，我们将疲劳相关参数视为非精确值，并基于生产过程中观测到的疲劳发展状况进行在线估计。针对这些挑战，本研究提出PF-CD3Q方法——一种融合粒子滤波器与约束对决双深度Q学习的安全生产强化学习框架，用于实现实时疲劳预测型人机任务规划与分配。具体而言，我们首先构建基于粒子滤波的估计器，以追踪人体疲劳状态并实时更新疲劳模型参数；继而通过决策过程中的任务级疲劳预测机制，将超出疲劳限值的任务排除在可选动作空间之外，从而将估计器嵌入CD3Q框架，将问题建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程。

Authors: Jintao Xue, Xiao Li, Nianmin Zhang

Designing for Error Recovery in Human-Robot Interaction

简要说明：这篇立场论文主张设计能检测和从错误中恢复的机器人AI系统，以人类适应性为灵感，并以核手套箱操作为例进行说明。

TLDR: This position paper advocates for designing robotic AI systems that focus on error detection and recovery, using human adaptability as inspiration and nuclear glovebox operations as a motivating example.

Abstract: This position paper looks briefly at the way we attempt to program robotic AI systems. Many AI systems are based on the idea of trying to improve the performance of one individual system to beyond so-called human baselines. However, these systems often look at one shot and one-way decisions, whereas the real world is more continuous and interactive. Humans, however, are often able to recover from and learn from errors - enabling a much higher rate of success. We look at the challenges of building a system that can detect/recover from its own errors, using the example of robotic nuclear gloveboxes as a use case to help illustrate examples. We then go on to talk about simple starting designs.

摘要（中文）：本立场文件简要探讨了机器人人工智能系统的编程思路。当前许多人工智能系统致力于将单个系统的性能提升至超越所谓人类基准的水平。然而，这类系统往往关注单次单向决策，而现实世界更具持续性与交互性。人类却能够从错误中恢复并汲取经验，从而达成更高的成功率。本文以核工业机器人手套箱为例，阐释构建具备错误检测与自我恢复能力系统所面临的挑战，并进一步探讨初步的基础设计方案。

Authors: Christopher D. Wallbridge, Erwin Jose Lopez Pulgarin

Ternary Logic Encodings of Temporal Behavior Trees with Application to Control Synthesis

简要说明：本文利用三值时序逻辑为行为树开发了一种形式化控制综合方法，通过混合整数优化为自主系统创建形式正确的控制策略。

TLDR: This paper develops a formal control synthesis method for Behavior Trees using a ternary-valued temporal logic to create correct-by-construction strategies for autonomous systems via mixed-integer optimization.

Abstract: Behavior Trees (BTs) provide designers an intuitive graphical interface to construct long-horizon plans for autonomous systems. To ensure their correctness and safety, rigorous formal models and verification techniques are essential. Temporal BTs (TBTs) offer a promising approach by leveraging existing temporal logic formalisms to specify and verify the executions of BTs. However, this analysis is currently limited to offline post hoc analysis and trace repair. In this paper, we reformulate TBTs using a ternary-valued Signal Temporal Logic (STL) amenable for control synthesis. Ternary logic introduces a third truth value \textit{Unknown}, formally capturing cases where a trajectory has neither fully satisfied or dissatisfied a specification. We propose mixed-integer linear encodings for partial trajectory STL and TBTs over ternary logic allowing for correct-by-construction control strategies for linear dynamical systems via mixed-integer optimization. We demonstrate the utility of our framework by solving optimal control problems.

摘要（中文）：行为树（BTs）为设计者提供了一种直观的图形界面，用于构建自主系统的长期规划。为确保其正确性和安全性，严谨的形式化模型与验证技术至关重要。时序行为树（TBTs）通过利用现有时序逻辑形式化方法来描述和验证行为树的执行过程，为此提供了一条前景广阔的路径。然而，目前此类分析仅限于离线事后分析和轨迹修复。本文采用适用于控制综合的三值信号时序逻辑（STL）对时序行为树进行重构。三值逻辑引入了第三个真值“未知”，从而在形式化层面捕捉轨迹既未完全满足也未完全违背规范的情形。针对三值逻辑下的部分轨迹STL和时序行为树，我们提出了混合整数线性编码方法，通过混合整数优化为线性动态系统实现构造即正确的控制策略。最后，通过求解最优控制问题验证了所提框架的实用性。

Authors: Ryan Matheu, John S. Baras, Calin Belta

Human-Inspired Context-Selective Multimodal Memory for Social Robots

简要说明：受人类认知启发，提出了一种用于社交机器人的多模态、上下文选择性记忆架构，旨在增强个性化、长期的人机交互。

TLDR: A multimodal, context-selective memory architecture for social robots, inspired by human cognition, to enhance personalized, long-term human-robot interaction.

Abstract: Memory is fundamental to social interaction, enabling humans to recall meaningful past experiences and adapt their behavior accordingly based on the context. However, most current social robots and embodied agents rely on non-selective, text-based memory, limiting their ability to support personalized, context-aware interactions. Drawing inspiration from cognitive neuroscience, we propose a context-selective, multimodal memory architecture for social robots that captures and retrieves both textual and visual episodic traces, prioritizing moments characterized by high emotional salience or scene novelty. By associating these memories with individual users, our system enables socially personalized recall and more natural, grounded dialogue. We evaluate the selective storage mechanism using a curated dataset of social scenarios, achieving a Spearman correlation of 0.506, surpassing human consistency ($ρ=0.415$) and outperforming existing image memorability models. In multimodal retrieval experiments, our fusion approach improves Recall@1 by up to 13\% over unimodal text or image retrieval. Runtime evaluations confirm that the system maintains real-time performance. Qualitative analyses further demonstrate that the proposed framework produces richer and more socially relevant responses than baseline models. This work advances memory design for social robots by bridging human-inspired selectivity and multimodal retrieval to enhance long-term, personalized human-robot interaction.

摘要（中文）：记忆是社会互动的基础，它使人类能够回忆有意义的历史经验，并根据情境调整行为。然而，当前大多数社交机器人与具身智能体依赖于非选择性的、基于文本的记忆，这限制了它们支持个性化、情境感知交互的能力。受认知神经科学启发，我们为社交机器人提出了一种情境选择性多模态记忆架构，该架构能够捕捉并检索文本与视觉的片段式记忆轨迹，并优先存储具有高情感显著性或场景新颖性的时刻。通过将这些记忆与个体用户关联，我们的系统实现了社交个性化记忆召回以及更自然、更接地的对话。我们使用精心编制的社交场景数据集对选择性存储机制进行评估，其斯皮尔曼相关系数达到0.506，超越了人类一致性水平（ρ=0.415），并优于现有图像记忆性模型。在多模态检索实验中，我们的融合方法将Recall@1指标较单模态文本或图像检索提升了最高13%。运行时评估证实系统能够保持实时性能。定性分析进一步表明，所提出的框架相较于基线模型能够生成更丰富且更具社交相关性的回应。本研究通过融合人类启发的选择性与多模态检索机制，推动了社交机器人记忆设计的进步，从而增强长期、个性化的人机交互体验。

Authors: Hangyeol Kang, Slava Voloshynovskiy, Nadia Magnenat Thalmann

Reading Between the Pixels: Linking Text-Image Embedding Alignment to Typographic Attack Success on Vision-Language Models

简要说明：本文分析了针对视觉语言模型的排版提示注入攻击，研究了字体大小和图像退化如何影响攻击成功率，并将其与图文嵌入对齐度相关联。

TLDR: This paper analyzes typographic prompt injection attacks on vision-language models, studying how font size and image degradations affect attack success rate and correlating it with text-image embedding alignment.

Abstract: We study typographic prompt injection attacks on vision-language models (VLMs), where adversarial text is rendered as images to bypass safety mechanisms, posing a growing threat as VLMs serve as the perceptual backbone of autonomous agents, from browser automation and computer-use systems to camera-equipped embodied agents. In practice, the attack surface is heterogeneous: adversarial text appears at varying font sizes and under diverse visual conditions, while the growing ecosystem of VLMs exhibits substantial variation in vulnerability, complicating defensive approaches. Evaluating 1,000 prompts from SALAD-Bench across four VLMs, namely, GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Mistral-Large-3, and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct under varying font sizes (6--28px) and visual transformations (rotation, blur, noise, contrast changes), we find: (1) font size significantly affects attack success rate (ASR), with very small fonts (6px) yielding near-zero ASR while mid-range fonts achieve peak effectiveness; (2) text attacks are more effective than image attacks for GPT-4o (36% vs 8%) and Claude (47% vs 22%), while Qwen3-VL and Mistral show comparable ASR across modalities; (3) text-image embedding distance from two multimodal embedding models (JinaCLIP and Qwen3-VL-Embedding) shows strong negative correlation with ASR across all four models (r = -0.71 to -0.93, p < 0.01); (4) heavy degradations increase embedding distance by 10--12% and reduce ASR by 34--96%, while rotation asymmetrically affects models (Mistral drops 50%, GPT-4o unchanged). These findings highlight that model-specific robustness patterns preclude one-size-fits-all defenses and offer empirical guidance for practitioners selecting VLM backbones for agentic systems operating in adversarial environments.

摘要（中文）：我们研究针对视觉语言模型的排版式提示注入攻击，该方法通过将对抗性文本渲染为图像来绕过安全机制。随着视觉语言模型日益成为自主智能体的感知核心——从浏览器自动化、计算机操作系统到配备摄像头的具身智能体，此类攻击构成了持续增长的威胁。在实际场景中，攻击面呈现高度异质性：对抗性文本以不同字体大小和多样视觉条件出现，而快速发展的视觉语言模型生态系统中各模型的脆弱性差异显著，这使防御策略复杂化。通过使用SALAD-Bench的1000个提示，在四种视觉语言模型（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Mistral-Large-3和Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct）上测试不同字体大小（6-28像素）和视觉变换（旋转、模糊、噪声、对比度变化）的影响，我们发现：（1）字体尺寸显著影响攻击成功率，极小字体（6像素）的攻击成功率接近零，而中等字体尺寸效果达到峰值；（2）对GPT-4o（36%对比8%）和Claude（47%对比22%），文本攻击比图像攻击更有效，而Qwen3-VL和Mistral在两种模态上攻击成功率相当；（3）两种多模态嵌入模型（JinaCLIP与Qwen3-VL-Embedding）的文本-图像嵌入距离与所有四种模型的攻击成功率均呈强负相关（r=-0.71至-0.93，p<0.01）；（4）重度图像退化会使嵌入距离增加10-12%，攻击成功率降低34-96%，而旋转对模型的影响具有不对称性（Mistral下降50%，GPT-4o保持不变）。这些发现表明，模型特定的鲁棒性模式排除了通用防御方案的可能性，并为从业者在对抗性环境中为智能体系统选择视觉语言模型主干提供了实证指导。
